title: Choosing a sampler from real renders and measures
hook: Fifteen real renders on one seed and a bench of 45 sampler names. What they can tell you, what they cannot, and a way to choose that survives both.

verified.claim: The ddim name is built with ksampler('euler', inpaint_options={'random': True}).
The ddim and euler renders on SD 1.5, seed 424242, have the same hash and the same measures.
verified.ref: renders.json from the Sampling Lab sweep

verified.claim: Bench numbers are copied from measures.json, made by ComfyUI's own samplers on a Gaussian toy with no network.
We looked at the euler, euler_ancestral, dpmpp_2m and lcm renders before describing them.

unchecked: Every render is one seed, one prompt and one model. None of them shows that one sampler is better than another.
The render times in renders.json were polled every 1.5 s, so we do not use them to compare speed.
That euler_cfg_pp equals euler on the bench because the bench has no guidance is our inference. We read the numbers, not a trace.
